en.name: Ryde Pier
en.text: The world's oldest working marine pier, opened in 1814, it features a railway line connecting the town to the mainland.

en.name: Quarr Abbey
en.text: A Benedictine monastery with striking red-brick architecture, known for its peaceful gardens and resident pigs.

en.name: Appley Tower
en.text: A distinctive Gothic folly tower on Appley Beach, built in 1875 as a garden house for a local estate.

en.name: Ryde Esplanade
en.text: The town's lively seafront featuring gardens, amusement parks, and views across the Solent to Portsmouth.

en.name: Puckpool Park
en.text: A former Victorian coastal battery that now serves as a public park with mini-golf and tennis courts.

en.name: Ryde Transport Interchange
en.text: A major transport hub connecting Island Line trains, buses, and the world's only year-round passenger hovercraft.

en.name: St Thomas' Church
en.text: This former church built in 1827 now functions as Ryde's heritage centre and museum of local history.

en.name: Ryde Town Hall
en.text: An elegant Neoclassical building with a clock tower, which formerly housed a theatre and council offices.

en.name: Canoe Lake
en.text: A large boating lake on the esplanade popular for swan-pedalo rides and feeding resident wildfowl.

en.name: Isle of Wight Bus Museum
en.text: Houses a collection of vintage buses and coaches that once served the island's unique transport network.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Ryde liegt an der Nordostküste der Isle of Wight und gilt als das Tor zur Insel. Die Stadt entwickelte sich im 19. Jahrhundert von einem kleinen Fischerdorf zu einem bedeutenden Seebad. Ein herausragendes Merkmal ist der Ryde Pier, der 1814 eröffnet wurde und damit der älteste Vergnügungspier in Großbritannien ist. Die Architektur im Stadtzentrum ist weitgehend von der viktorianischen und georgianischen Ära geprägt, was sich in den eleganten Fassaden entlang der Union Street widerspiegelt. Wirtschaftlich ist Ryde stark vom Tourismus und dem Einzelhandel abhängig, bietet aber auch wichtige Verkehrsverbindungen zum Festland. Besonders hervorzuheben ist der Hovertravel-Dienst, der die einzige kommerzielle Hovercraft-Route der Welt betreibt. Die Stadt beheimatet zudem den Ryde Carnival, den ältesten Karneval des Landes, der jedes Jahr Tausende Besucher anzieht. Geographisch zeichnet sich die Region durch flache Küstenabschnitte und fruchtbares Hinterland aus, das ideal für Wanderungen ist.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Ryde a Wight-sziget északkeleti partján fekszik, és gyakran a sziget kapujaként emlegetik. A város a 19. század során fejlődött kis halászfaluból jelentős tengerparti üdülőhellyé. Legismertebb építménye a Ryde Pier, amelyet 1814-ben adtak át, így ez Nagy-Britannia legrégebbi szórakoztató mólója. A városközpont építészete főként a viktoriánus és a georgiánus korszak jegyeit viseli magán, ami különösen az Union Street elegáns homlokzatain látható. Gazdaságilag Ryde jelentős mértékben támaszkodik a turizmusra és a kiskereskedelemre, emellett fontos közlekedési csomópont a szárazföld felé. Itt üzemel a Hovertravel, amely a világ egyetlen menetrend szerinti kereskedelmi légpárnás hajó útvonalát tartja fenn. A város ad otthont a Ryde Carnivalnak is, amely az ország legrégebbi karneválja, és minden évben látogatók ezreit vonzza. Földrajzi szempontból a régiót lankás part menti szakaszok és termékeny hátország jellemzi.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Ryde este situat pe coasta de nord-est a Insulei Wight și este considerat poarta de intrare pe insulă. Orașul s-a dezvoltat în secolul al XIX-lea dintr-un mic sat de pescari într-o stațiune balneară importantă. O caracteristică remarcabilă este Ryde Pier, deschis în 1814, fiind cel mai vechi dig de agrement din Marea Britanie. Arhitectura din centrul orașului este în mare parte marcată de epocile victoriană și georgiană, reflectată în fațadele elegante de-a lungul străzii Union Street. Din punct de vedere economic, Ryde depinde în mare măsură de turism și comerțul cu amănuntul, oferind totodată legături de transport vitale către continent. Un aspect deosebit este serviciul Hovertravel, care operează singura rută comercială de hovercraft din lume. Orașul găzduiește, de asemenea, Carnavalul din Ryde, cel mai vechi carnaval din țară, care atrage anual mii de vizitatori. Geografic, regiunea se distinge prin secțiuni de coastă plate și un hinterland fertil, ideal pentru drumeții.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Ryde is situated on the northeast coast of the Isle of Wight and is widely regarded as the gateway to the island. The town evolved during the 19th century from a small fishing village into a major seaside resort. A standout feature is Ryde Pier, which opened in 1814, making it the oldest pleasure pier in Great Britain. The architecture in the town center is predominantly influenced by the Victorian and Georgian eras, visible in the elegant facades along Union Street. Economically, Ryde relies heavily on tourism and retail, while also serving as a vital transport link to the mainland. Of particular note is the Hovertravel service, which operates the world's only scheduled commercial hovercraft route. The town is also home to the Ryde Carnival, the oldest carnival in the country, attracting thousands of visitors every year. Geographically, the area is characterized by flat coastal stretches and a fertile hinterland, perfect for walking and exploration.
